apple.rule: Measure sphere center and table; side grasp with calibrated seating and lift verification.

canned_juice.rule: Fit cylinder/cap axis; align actual finger midline before straight insertion; use legacy calibrated depth; one closure and measured lift.

ground_pepper.rule: Fit wide body separately from cap; pinch body, set height from support, not whole-image bbox center.

toy_penguin.rule: Use established penguin geometry and measured hold verification; do not assume every head/torso orientation was verified.

cigarette.rule: Choose contact height using complete finger closing envelope above table; do not drive fingers to a low box center.

tumbler.rule: Measure round body center/width and support; calibrated side grasp; verify actual surface follows palm.

toy_car.rule: User requires overhead. Find a material-bearing narrow part; automatic side grasp success does not verify overhead lift.

game_controller.rule: Generate local handle candidates; prior manually reviewed image anchor must not be reused as automatic evidence.

fallback.wide_object: exclude side if measured minimum horizontal width exceeds physical opening; overhead still requires feasible contact and clearance

failure_policy: Never switch methods after an attempted closure without checking current holding state. Failed or unknown measurement is not evidence of an unsuitable pose. No automatic replay of historical XYZ.
